div.head: Abt 61.1
div.ab: Gif he þurhðirel weorðeþ, XX scill' gebete.
Gif he þurhðirel weorðeþ, XX scill' gebete.
Gif he þurhðirel weorðeþ, XX sciƚƚ gebete.
Wenn er durchbohrt wird, büsse er 20 Schill.
If he is pierced through, let him pay 20 shillings.
If it be pierced through, 20 shillings shall be paid as compensation.
If he becomes pierced through, let him pay [with] 20 shillings.

note.seg: Erhöhung der Gliederbusse (s. d. Gl 8 A) bei zweimündiger Wunde kennt auch festländisches Recht beim Bauche, Englisches bei anderen Körperteilen
An increased compensation for limbs (see that word in Gl 8 A) in the case of a wound with two openings is also known to continental law for the belly, and to English law for other parts of the body

note.label: shillings.
note.seg: That is, the wound goes right through the injured man: he cannot refer to either the stomach (hrif, neuter) or the wound (wund, feminine).
